info.description: The header and footer navigation, and any scripts injected into every page such as a tag manager. Changing this affects every page on the site.

favicon.description: The icon browsers show on the tab and in bookmarks. An SVG is sharpest and scales to every size; a square PNG of at least 180x180 also works. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the site.

siteName.description: The name of the site, used in the share-preview metadata and the footer copyright. Not the page title.

logo.description: The lockup in the header. An SVG keeps it sharp at any size. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the site.

footerLogo.description: The mark beside the copyright line. The original uses a smaller, simpler mark here than in the header, so this is a separate field rather than the header logo scaled down.

defaultMetaDescription.description: Used for the search and share preview of any page that does not set its own description.

defaultSocialImage.description: The picture shown when a page is shared and has no image of its own. Around 1200x630 works everywhere.

socialLinks.description: The icon links at the foot of the page. Pick artwork from the social set of the Icon Library.

headScripts.description: Raw markup injected at the end of <head> on every page, e.g. the Google Tag Manager snippet.

bodyScripts.description: Raw markup injected immediately after <body> opens, e.g. the GTM noscript iframe.
